Exercise: Rhomboids-SMR

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
None

Force Type:
static

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- shifting
- unilateral_rolling

Primary Muscles:

- middle back

Secondary Muscles:

- traps

Equipment:

- foam_roll

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
low to moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- improve_myofascial_release_of_the_middle_back_and_traps

Contraindications:

- acute back pain
- recent spinal surgery

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:
None

Instructions:

- Lay down with your back on the floor. Place a foam roll underneath your upper back, and cross your arms in front of you, protracting your shoulders. This will be your starting position.
- Raise your hips off of the ground, placing your weight onto the foam roll. Shift your weight to one side at a time, rolling over your middle and upper back. Pause at points of tension for 10-30 seconds.
